findings.message: `v.started_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)` compares DATETIME `v.started_at` with a date, which means midnight, so it keeps the rest of that day too.
findings.fix: Start from the next day instead: `v.started_at >= DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY)`.

findings.message: `v.started_at <= CURRENT_DATE()` compares DATETIME `v.started_at` with a date, which means midnight, so it leaves out the rest of that day.
findings.fix: Compare with the next day instead: `v.started_at < DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)`.
